Question Text: Ignoring air resistance, an object is dropped from rest. Using g ≈ 10 m/s², determine the speed it has gained after 4 s.
Answer 1: 40 m/s upward
Answer 2: 40 m/s downward
Answer 4: 20 m/s downward

Question Text: For ideal free fall from rest, use d = ½gt² with g ≈ 10 m/s². Compare the total distance fallen after 3 s and 4 s. Then explain why a coffee filter falling at terminal speed would not follow this same pattern.
Answer 1: Distance increases by the same amount each second because acceleration is constant.
Answer 2: The filter follows exactly the same t² pattern because all falling objects are always in free fall.
Answer 4: After 3 s: 45 m; after 4 s: 80 m. The ideal distance grows with t². A filter with significant air resistance is not in ideal free fall and can reach nearly constant speed.

Question Text: Two compact objects of different masses are released together in a vacuum chamber near Earth. Predict which reaches the floor first and explain using the meaning of free fall.
Answer 1: The heavier object arrives first because gravity gives it a larger acceleration.
Answer 2: The lighter object arrives first because it has less inertia.
Answer 3: Neither accelerates because a vacuum removes gravity.
Answer 4: They reach the floor together if released from the same height with the same initial velocity. With air resistance ignored, both have the same downward acceleration g.
